description: Log exactly one confirmed income payment (cash/check/Stripe/etc.) to Income, e.g. income absent from Gmail/Plaid; no server preview, it writes on call. Never loop over statements/exports/tables/lists. Multiple payments: add_income_from_csv for CSV/TSV/text or add_income_from_file for image/PDF; both duplicate-check, preview and require confirmation. Call list_income_categories first; use fixed tax categories. Omitted category defaults to Service income; unknown is rejected.

category.description: A category returned by list_income_categories (optional; defaults to Service income)

date.description: Income date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required. Use the date the user gives; for "today" send today's calendar date in their timezone. If no date was given, ask.

paymentMethod.description: How you got paid: Cash, Check, Bank transfer, Wallet app, Credit/Debit card, Payment processor or Other; labels like Stripe or Venmo are normalized.

source.description: Who paid you (client name, customer, etc.)

name: add_income
